vs
Deputy Commissioner, Narsingdi and others ------- Defendant-Respondent-Opposite-Parties
full_judgment: The First Appeal No. 4 of 1993 was preferred by the plaintiff-appellant-petitioners against the impugned judgment and decree dated 30-9-1992 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Narsingdi in Title Suit No. 66 of 1987 dismissing the suit on contest against the defendant-respondent-opposite-parties and ultimately the appeal came up for final hearing before a Bench of the High Court Division on 25-8-2003 and since no one appeared on behalf of the plaintiff-appellant-petitioners on 25-8-2003. It was dismissed for default. Subsequently after a lapse of 297 days, the plaintiff-appellant-petitioners came up with the instant petition for re-admission of the appeal after setting aside the order of dismissal of the appeal dated 25-8-2003 whereupon the present Rule was obtained.
